skill.name: smc-harness
skill.description: Guides Alpha Harness agents through ICT and Smart Money Concepts backtesting. It helps analyze BTC/USDT structure, record setups, manage simulated orders, and document decisions.

content.value_statement: Trading agents need a repeatable process for simulated BTC/USDT decisions. This skill provides ICT and SMC rules for analysis, setup logging, order handling, and review.
actual_capabilities: Defines a wake protocol for orienting, analyzing, deciding, acting, and setting alarms.
Explains ICT and Smart Money Concepts for 4H bias and 15m entry timing.
Provides criteria for TRADE, WATCH, NOTE, and NOTHING decisions.
Documents setup types such as ChoCH FVG, BOS OB, liquidity sweep, and breaker patterns.
Shows simulated order construction with entry, stop, target, size, and expiry fields.
Includes examples for long, short, continuation, watch, note, and no-trade scenarios.
limitations: It is written for Alpha Harness backtesting, not live exchange trading.
It focuses on BTC/USDT with 4H and 15m timeframes.
It provides methodology guidance and does not guarantee profitable results.
It depends on available harness commands and closed candle data.

use_cases.title: Run Structured Backtests
use_cases.description: Use the wake protocol to make consistent simulated decisions across repeated BTC/USDT sessions.

use_cases.title: Train Trading Agents
use_cases.description: Give an AI agent clear rules for setup selection, risk limits, and decision records.

use_cases.title: Review SMC Decisions
use_cases.description: Compare recorded trades against predefined ICT and SMC criteria during post-run analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Harness Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the SMC Harness wake protocol for the current BTC/USDT session. Summarize state, market bias, possible actions, and next alarm needs.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this BTC/USDT setup against the TRADE criteria. Check HTF bias, liquidity sweep, LTF confirmation, entry zone, risk reward, and constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Between Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Decide whether to TRADE, WATCH, NOTE, or do NOTHING. Explain which criteria are met, which criteria are missing, and what action follows.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Completed Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these recorded setups and orders for rule adherence. Identify decision quality, missed constraints, risk issues, and lessons for future sessions.

output_examples.input: A bullish BTC/USDT sweep forms near a 4H discount zone with a 15m change of character.
output_examples.output: The skill would classify the setup, check confluence, compare reward to risk, and describe whether a simulated order is justified.

output_examples.input: The agent already has one pending order and sees another possible entry.
output_examples.output: The skill would tell the agent to manage the active order first and avoid placing a second order.

output_examples.input: Price approaches a point of interest, but confirmation is incomplete.
output_examples.output: The skill would favor a WATCH decision, record the setup, and set an alarm for the next relevant trigger.

best_practices: Use the skill only in the Alpha Harness backtesting environment.
Record reasoning for every setup before placing a simulated order.
Keep the one-order and two-percent risk constraints visible during each session.
anti_patterns: Do not use the examples as live financial advice.
Do not place a simulated order before creating a matching setup.
Do not trade when the required bias, sweep, confirmation, or reward criteria are missing.

faq.question: Does this skill trade with real funds?
faq.answer: No. The skill is written for Alpha Harness backtesting and simulated BTC/USDT orders.

faq.question: Which markets does it cover?
faq.answer: The included methodology targets BTC/USDT with 4H bias analysis and 15m entry timing.

faq.question: Can Claude or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No evidence of executable scripts was found. The files are Markdown instructions and reference material.

faq.question: What decisions does it support?
faq.answer: It supports TRADE, WATCH, NOTE, and NOTHING decisions with criteria for each path.

faq.question: Does it guarantee profitable trades?
faq.answer: No. It provides a repeatable simulated decision process, not performance guarantees.
